## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)
library(gifski)
```

## Q1

```{r}
who <- read_csv("WHO-COVID-19-global-data.csv")

top3 <- who %>%
  filter(Date_reported == max(Date_reported)) %>%
  arrange(-Cumulative_deaths) %>%
  head(3)

top3
```

## Q2

```{r}
who2 <- who %>%
  filter(Country %in% top3$Country)

ggplot(who2, aes(x = Date_reported, y = Cumulative_deaths, color = Country)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "COVID-19 Deaths Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Total Deaths",
    caption = "Source: WHO COVID-19 Data"
  ) +
  transition_reveal(Date_reported)
```

## Q3

```{r}
who <- who %>%
  mutate(death_per_cases = Cumulative_deaths / Cumulative_cases)

top3_rate <- who %>%
  filter(Date_reported == max(Date_reported),
         Cumulative_cases > 0) %>%
  arrange(-death_per_cases) %>%
  head(3)

top3_rate
```

## Q4

```{r}
who3 <- who %>%
  filter(Country %in% c("United States of America", "Italy", "Mexico"))

ggplot(who3, aes(x = Date_reported, y = death_per_cases, color = Country)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "COVID-19 Deaths per Case",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Deaths per Case",
    caption = "Comparison of the US, Italy, and Mexico"
  ) +
  transition_reveal(Date_reported)
```

## Q5

```{r}
vacc <- read_csv("vaccinations.csv")

vacc2 <- vacc %>%
  filter(location %in% c("High income", "Upper middle income",
                         "Lower middle income", "Low income"))

ggplot(vacc2, aes(x = date, y = total_vaccinations_per_hundred,
                  color = location)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "COVID-19 Vaccinations by Income Level",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Total Vaccinations per 100 People",
    caption = "Higher-income countries generally vaccinated faster than lower-income countries."
  ) +
  transition_reveal(date)
```
